[EN] During these abductions, the Explorer Guild really stepped up.

Dragonfall has enough guards to deal with crime and hold the walls until Kaiator sends relief.

The guild aren't army or government, though some of them are veterans. They're staying with us.

Maybe dying with us...
[ES] Durante estos secuestros, el Explorer Guild realmente dio un paso al frente.

Dragonfall tiene suficientes guardias para lidiar con el crimen y mantener los muros hasta que Kaiator envíe refuerzos.

El gremio no es ni ejército ni gobierno, aunque algunos son veteranos. Se quedan con nosotros.

Tal vez para morir con nosotros...
